author: Islam Ibrahim - Carrots Team
fullName: LOD 3D — screen-space LOD, QEM and Terrain3D
name: LOD3D
shortDescription: Engine-grade level of detail for GDevelop 3D: screen-space LOD, budgeted quadric simplification, authored LOD meshes, shadow LOD, scatter LOD and a dedicated crack-free Terrain3D adapter.
description: LOD 3D replaces distance-threshold geometry swapping with a screen-space LOD system built for GDevelop and Three.js r185.
Why it looks and performs better than the old LOD:

- LOD is selected from the projected size of the object's real bounding sphere (resolution and FOV independent), with hysteresis, so large objects are not over-simplified and small ones are not kept at full detail.

- Generated levels use a quadric error metric (QEM) edge-collapse simplifier, not vertex clustering. Borders, UV seams and per-corner normals/UVs/colors are preserved, so meshes keep their shape and textures.
- Simplification runs in small time slices (default 2.5 ms per frame) with a per-geometry cache. Authored LOD meshes (LOD0/LOD1/... or userData.lodLevel) are used when present.
- Shadow LOD keeps off-screen shadow casters alive. The old behavior (hiding far roots) removed their shadows; this system only disables shadow casting when the projected size is too small to matter.

- Terrain3D is handled by a dedicated adapter: terrain chunks are never vertex-clustered. Chunk levels use projected error and crack-free index steps (with the terrain skirts), chunks are frustum-culled, and terrain shadow casting is distance/size based.
- ScatteredModels chunks (InstancedMesh) get their own LOD, so forests and rocks are simplified with their draw distance.
- FSR1 is detected and its legacy LOD is disabled, so FSR1 + LOD3D can be used together without double simplification or terrain corruption.

Quick start: at the beginning of the scene use "Enable automatic 3D LOD" with Balanced. For a sharper result use Quality, for weak GPUs use Performance or Mobile. Optional per-object bias: create an object variable named LODBias (0.5 = less detail, 2 = more detail).

eventsFunctions.description: Enables screen-space LOD for every 3D object, model, scattered-model chunk and 3D terrain of the scene. Geometry is simplified on demand with a budgeted quadric simplifier, shadows are reduced with distance, and the setting is kept for the next scenes. If FSR1 is installed, its legacy LOD is disabled automatically so the two systems never fight.
